english.title: Cause / permit use of a vehicle that fails to comply with braking / steering etc requirements on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the use of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which failed to comply with the

(C)_[braking]_
(D)_[steering]_
(E)_[lighting]_
(F)_[tyre]_
(G)_[electrical]_

requirements, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REQUIREMENTS..), which would have applied to that type of vehicle had it been operated on a road to which the road traffic enactments applied, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.6 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
